item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import work\\n\\ndef check(got,want): assert got == want, (got,want)\\np={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'d'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncheck(work.evaluate({'layers':[{'i':1},{'i':2,'b':False},{'s':''}]},p),{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':2,'s':''},'error':None})\\ncheck(work.evaluate({'layers':[{'i':None}]},p),{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'d'},'error':None})\\nfor value in [True,False,1.0,'1',None]: check(work.evaluate({'layers':[{'i':value}]},dict(p,null_resets=False)),{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'})\\nfor raw,val in [('+0',0),('-0',0),('+12',12),('-12',-12),('001',1)]: check(work.evaluate({'environment':{'i':raw}},p),{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':val,'s':'d'},'error':None})\\nfor raw in ['', ' 1','1 ','1.0','++1','١']:\\n check(work.evaluate({'environment':{'i':raw}},p),{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'})\\nfor raw in ['True','FALSE']:\\n check(work.evaluate({'environment':{'b':raw}},p),{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'})\\nprint('edge checks passed')\"]}"}
